reviewNotes: Reviewed all 140 speech keys against all 20 source cards in data/pages47-49-materials.json. Checked contextual topic は → わ, directional へ → え, object を → お; preserved lexical 刃 は, はさき, はもち, はがね, はわたり, はんのう, はんたい, はじめる, はさむ, はもの and lexical へこむ, へいめん, へんしょく. Checked しろがみこう, あおがみこう, せいかいしょく, ふどうたいひまく, あらと, なかと, しあげと, じがね, うらおし, きえ, けんさく, はつけ and ぼうせいゆ against source readings. Loanwords converted to hiragana preserving long vowels; sequence arrows rendered as pauses. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
